coverage.description: ancestry_path/walk and ancestry call adapters in materialise/story/other_branch; excludes file I/O, formatting and branch selection

obernants.domain: Fixed finite maps from IDs to (parent,time,metric,note), requested ID and strict/permissive missing policy; successful allocation.
obernants.observation_scope: Pure path/error transition; adapter ordering is source-inspected only.
obernants.operator: U=(map,id,policy,path-or-error); U minus Walk excludes successful paths with repeated IDs, skipped parents, included origin, or missing terminal under strict mode; it excludes wrong error partitions.
obernants.approximation_semantics: Conditional source-derived target; finite observations do not prove universal correspondence.
